root.statement: Select and verify the smallest end-to-end product slices that materially move Soltex from engineering console to dependable daily-use Windows utility.
root.source_state: Exact-head installed Soltex is functional and visually coherent but cold-eye review found weak cross-module flow, clipped Security activity, passive sparse states, and no recoverable Audio mix recall.
root.target_state: The native app exposes fast navigation and at least one deep, recoverable, read-back-backed workflow while preserving security, privacy, lifecycle, and performance boundaries.
conditions: Do not copy proprietary SteelSeries expression or change SteelSeries settings.
Do not weaken Windows Security, add exclusions, or claim replacement antivirus behavior.
Do not overwrite the protected owner checkout or its dirty files.
Keep human visual acceptance separate from automated verification.
root.boundary: The isolated sol/soltex-product-rebuild worktree, its existing local Windows runtime, branch-scoped GitHub evidence, and the already-installed read-only SteelSeries GG reference.

hard_gates.rationale: The user explicitly authorized finishing the tool end-to-end within the established project.
Planned changes are bounded app controls and local state; no stress, driver, or protection-disabling work is in scope.
Audio snapshots retain only displayed app and endpoint labels plus levels; no raw Core Audio IDs or paths are persisted. GG is reference-only.
Only the existing feature branch and draft PR may be updated after verification; no release publication is authorized by this gate.
No production deployment or destructive source operation is part of the current slice.
Implementation may proceed while final visual acceptance and production signing/release decisions remain explicitly reserved to the owner.
Source changes are isolated and reviewable; new local Audio snapshot state is explicitly clearable and must recover from malformed input.

hypotheses.statement: A searchable keyboard command surface and explicit shortcuts will reduce cross-module friction without increasing visible information density.
hypotheses.mechanism: Ctrl+K offers one focused overlay over the existing navigation model and routes through the same ShowPanel state transition.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: Keyboard and click tests can reach every visible workspace and focus returns safely after dismissal.
hypotheses.falsifier: The overlay traps focus, duplicates state, or makes 1280 x 820 containment worse.
hypotheses.decision_if_true: Ship the command surface and keep the sidebar quiet.

confidence.basis: Bounded catalog tests, shared routing, and native command-surface capture passed.

hypotheses.statement: A single bounded Audio mix snapshot provides meaningful recovery and product depth without pretending to be an EQ or virtual audio router.
hypotheses.mechanism: Persist displayed app and endpoint labels plus volume/mute, re-observe live sessions, apply only exact controllable matches, and require Core Audio read-back for each write.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: Store tests recover from invalid data and planner/controller tests report verified, missing, and failed entries explicitly.
hypotheses.falsifier: The snapshot can target ambiguous sessions, persists raw identifiers, or hides partial failure.
hypotheses.decision_if_true: Expose capture, apply, and confirmed clear controls in Audio.

confidence.basis: Persistence, matching, recovery, privacy, action-state, and native UI tests passed.
